uncertainty.coder_notes: The PRE response enumerated several audience types in a single sentence-style list, while POST fully segmented two of them. Segmentation of Real Estate Developers yielded both a Reframed (audience reconceived with depth) and an Elaborated (demographic/behavioral detail added) event, which risks collapsing distinct changes. The Reframed pairing of consumer automation behavior with interior-designer interest in home automation is arguable; subsumption test fails (designer interest is not a specific way of being consumer convenience), but the thematic overlap supports a Reframed verdict. Several audience removals (home-owners, foreign investors, businesspeople) are clean different-domain removals. The new Interior Designers audience and its segmentation account for most new events; demographic specification is recorded as New rather than Expanded because the income-bracket overlap with home-owners is incidental, not lineage.
